name: ryd
biography: Jens Muecke did the coding job. He wrote one service for the CTF at Hackers at Random (HAR) Camp in the Netherlands and is one of the authors of the chaosvpn software. He gave a talk at 24c3, toorcamp and some other conferences. He beleives in hackerspaces to play CTF and have his home in CCC hamburg.
